text:
harper (PM): quick callout: proposing we defer per-tenant quantization profile management from MVP to v1. MVP ships with a single quant profile per model family. saves ~2 sprint infra lift. agree?

drew (Eng): sounds reasonable. profile management touches model-storage, CI, and runtime selection. estimate 6 dev-weeks otherwise.

mina (Eng-ML): caveat: some customers rely on different quant levels for cost vs quality. we should offer an ops-managed override for 1-2 enterprise tenants during MVP.

rafa (Design): UX: console shouldn't show an unfinished "quant profiles" area. hide until v1 and add a banner explaining enterprise overrides.

taylor (SRE): runtime concerns: ensure model variant selection is pinned per deployment to avoid accidental mixing. add a canary for any override changes.

sam (CS): customers cares: we'll pre-notify top accounts. offer managed override + rollback guarantee.

harper (PM): action items:
- harper: update milestone tracker and exec note (today)
- drew: implement runtime pin + ops-override hook (2w)
- mina: add evals for two enterprise tenants before any override
- rafa: banner + support FAQ (EOD Fri)
- taylor: rollback canary + alerts (this sprint)

sam (CS): i'll draft customer outreach.

harper (PM): final: defer quant profile management to v1; MVP includes single profile + managed overrides for up to 2 customers. proceed unless anyone objects by EOD. :white_check_mark:
